compile_cython_extension: run the setup script to compile data_utils_cython.pyx into a .so shared object with O3 optimization
build_cython_data_utils: build the data_utils_cython Cython extension module from the .pyx source file using cythonize
review_cython_compile_setup: review the cython compile setup script that configures Extension with O3 compile and link flags
summarize_cython_build_config: summarize the Cython build configuration that compiles data_utils_cython.pyx into a native extension
refactor_cython_compile_args: refactor the cython compile script to add or modify extra compile and link arguments for the extension
